dossier.summary: Claude Code CLI 2.1.117 is represented as an exact publisher release with unresolved installed asset and model backend, while current permission, sandbox and model documentation remains rolling-current and is not silently applied to the exact client.

releaseContext.statement: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.117 on 2026-04-22 and linked commit 2fa67717b8046c253cfa55fd84002e3501f1eca6. Current documentation has evolved beyond this release and is scoped separately.

limitations: All product claims are attributed to Anthropic public sources; no product behavior was observed.
No Claude Code release asset was downloaded, installed, hashed or run.
Current permission, sandbox and model pages are rolling documentation and do not freeze 2.1.117 behavior.
The exact release page identifies a tag and commit but not the installed platform asset or digest.
Permission mode, sandbox state, model provider, endpoint and MCP configuration remain unresolved.
The Overeager paper is retained only as unresolved potential evidence; no result is included.
No capability, quality, performance, safety, privacy or suitability conclusion is supported.
